children: France-based Human Cell Design, a biotechnology company focused on human cell models for diabetes, obesity and other metabolic diseases.
The financial terms were not disclosed and is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

The deal will add Human Cell Design's human pancreatic beta cell models to Revvity’s Life Sciences portfolio, strengthening its capabilities in drug discovery and screening for GLP-1 and other metabolic disease therapies.
The acquired technology will also expand Revvity’s potential applications in regenerative medicine and cell-based therapies.

title: Revvity to acquire Human Cell Design
